# Vendored visualization dependencies

The browser bundles in this directory are pinned copies of the dependencies
previously loaded from jsDelivr:

- `vega.min.js`: Vega 5.22.1, downloaded from
  `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/vega@5.22.1/build/vega.min.js`
- `vega-embed.min.js`: vega-embed 6.20.8, downloaded from
  `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/vega-embed@6.20.8/build/vega-embed.min.js`

Their upstream licenses are included alongside the bundles. The SHA-256
checksums of the vendored files are:

```
731f01b68116bc185a196322096ca342737424c4995c48a6674f57ebc967e9c1  vega.min.js
e5c92904f1b614e54a6a860ecf194ca88bf948b4faeb7af9a0fe2cad93dc730e  vega-embed.min.js
```
